shadows.cardResting.absent: the kit's teaser cards and banners carry no drop shadow; depth comes from the sage fill and the 4px banner border

normalizations.why: Inter is OFL and self-hosted from /fonts; the stack is the exact computed string the page and EDS styles emit
Lexia (Dalton Maag) is a licensed AstraZeneca face: adopted as the token string, never rebundled; Roboto Slab (Apache-2.0, self-hosted) is the nearest open slab-serif fallback

curations.rule: mobile module instances are 343px wide inside the 375px mobile frame: (375 - 343) / 2 = 16px per side
mobile frames stack modules on the kit's pad-24 spacing step (the documentation frames' mobile panels pad 24px)
Teaser / Card Desktop content frame (Frame 2) is auto-layout pad 24,24,24,24 gap 16
the card .Title text node fills #d0006f (Magenta) in every Card content variant

suspect.why: pad-40 is the most frequent vertical padding but most instances sit on documentation frames; no full-page frame of the kit shows band-to-band rhythm at 1440

modules.name: Header (oneAZ Header / Full)
modules.anatomy: brand logo left + primary nav items (Inter 14/500, sub-nav chevrons) + utility links row (Contact / language selector) + search icon + outlined Login button; mobile: logo + search + hamburger

modules.name: Home Hero Branded
modules.anatomy: split hero on a sage (rgb 235,239,238) band: brand logo, Lexia h1 56/60 in plum, Inter 18/28 lede, one primary button left; full-height image right; mobile stacks image above text

modules.name: Teaser / Home Hero (impact)
modules.anatomy: full-bleed image band with dark overlay: white Lexia impact headline, white Inter lede, one primary button; Large/Medium/Small heights, Left/Center/Right content alignment

modules.name: Teaser / Text + Image
modules.anatomy: two-column row: image one side, Lexia heading (plum) + Inter body + primary button the other; Alignment Left|Right alternates the image side; mobile stacks image above text

modules.name: Teaser / Card grid
modules.anatomy: section title (.Title Teaser) + grid of sage cards (radius 8): image top, italic Inter tag (Event/News…), Lexia card heading in magenta, Inter body, primary button; 3-up at 1440, 1-up on mobile

modules.name: Teaser / Card grid — 3 Teasers composition
modules.anatomy: the kit's .Block Element '3 Teasers' composition: three Teaser / Card instances 366.67 wide in a 1180 row, gap 40; mobile stacks them 375 wide, gap 16

modules.name: CTA Banner
modules.anatomy: white panel with 4px grey (rgb 178,180,180) border and radius 8, padding 40: small image left, Lexia heading (plum), Inter body, optional input, primary/secondary/tertiary buttons row, trailing small print

modules.name: Footer
modules.anatomy: white footer: brand logo + short mission paragraph left; two columns of Inter 14 links; social icon row (LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, X) + job-code small print

modules.name: Links (in-page nav)
modules.anatomy: in-page nav items: Inter 14/700 magenta links with a 4px amber (rgb 240,171,0) left rule, optional em-dash nesting; horizontal row at 1440, vertical list on mobile

modules.name: Block Content
modules.why: a composite documentation page; its .Block Element set (12534:1413) is included as M5b for the 3-up card composition, the rest is covered by M3/M4

modules.name: Carousel
modules.why: no captured content slot is a carousel; M5 covers card runs statically

modules.name: Breadcrumb
modules.why: the archetype (home) has no breadcrumb; revisit for inner-page siblings

modules.name: Accordion
modules.why: no disclosure content on the archetype

modules.name: Back to top
modules.why: a floating utility atom, not a section-level module

modules.name: Chips
modules.why: an atom; the chip spec is carried by radii.chip

notesForReskin: Headings are sentence case in Lexia (regular weight, never bold) — plum rgb(131,0,81) on light grounds, magenta rgb(208,0,111) for teaser-card headings, white over imagery. Body copy is Inter 16/24 in rgb(60,66,66). Primary buttons are solid magenta with white Inter 16/700 labels, 4px radius, 42px tall, 16px side padding; secondary is the outlined inverse. Bands alternate white and sage rgb(235,239,238); cards sit on sage with 8px radius and no shadow. Amber rgb(240,171,0) is reserved for the in-page-nav rule and the logo spark.
motifs: sage-on-white banding: content cards and branded heroes sit on rgb(235,239,238) panels against a white page
Lexia slab-serif headings at regular weight paired with Inter body — the serif carries the brand voice
one solid magenta primary action per module; outlined magenta secondary; underlined tertiary
4px grey bordered CTA banner panel as the only bordered surface

design.description: AstraZeneca's oneAZ web kit: a calm white-and-sage system with Lexia slab-serif headings, Inter body copy and a single magenta action colour.

narrative.northStar: Trustworthy clarity: one serif voice, one action colour, generous sage panels.
narrative.overview: White pages carry sage-tinted panels for heroes and cards; Lexia headings in plum or magenta lead each module and one magenta button closes it.
keyCharacteristics: magenta as the only action colour
rules: headings in Lexia regular, never bold
dos: alternate image side on consecutive text+image teasers
keep cards on the sage fill with 8px radius
